controls.requirement: Do not report notice, explanation, restoration, compensation, feature retirement, workflow change, model revision, and verification as interchangeable.
Every consequential exertion has a named actor able to inspect and alter it.
Preserve inputs, outputs, versions, thresholds, notices, contrary evidence, and decision authorship.
Give an independent actor authority to pause processing or adverse action before irreversible harm.
Return intelligible evidence, factors, reasons, and relevant personal data.
Join safety, accommodation, welfare, protected activity, and representative context before adverse use.
Require time, competence, independence, contrary evidence, and authority to suspend, override, and reverse.
Correct erroneous classification, process, and downstream records.
Restore work access, duties, account, status, records, reputation, and support.
Separate worker-facing compensation from regulator fines or institutional settlements.
Remove or prohibit a harmful feature, data use, or deployment where repair is insufficient.
Change notice, review, escalation, retention, support, and decision workflows after confirmed failure.
Change model features, thresholds, training data, or scoring logic after confirmed failure or record a reviewable refusal.
Independently test whether promised deletion, retirement, restoration, and revision occurred.
Provide authorised representatives with aggregate patterns, overrides, remedies, drift, and recurring failure evidence.
Include exits, silence, deterrence, successful challenges, reinstatements, and external outcomes in later validation.

states.required_record: Name the system, purpose, affected workers, decision classes, and prohibited uses.
Retain exact worker data, recipients, retention, and off-duty or representative boundaries.
Retain the claimed construct, model or rule version, features, thresholds, and uncertainty.
Classify protected activity, safety, accommodation, welfare, and representative context before adverse use.
Give affected workers and authorised representatives timely notice of the system and possible consequences.
Retain the exact output, score, alert, trigger, and system identity.
Name an actor with access, independence, time, competence, and authority to alter the transaction.
Pause processing or action where rights, safety, accommodation, evidence, or review remains unresolved.
Return source evidence, factors, reasons, and a correction path.
Resolve the decision and constrain access, pay, duty, scheduling, and communication restrictions.
Restore account, duties, pay status, records, reputation, and support where required.
Repair worker-facing financial loss where established.
Retire or revise the feature, use, workflow, policy, training, or vendor configuration.
Revise or explicitly retain the model, threshold, features, or data with reviewable reasons.
Verify deletion, deployment, review quality, restoration, and non-recurrence.
Include overturns, reinstatements, exits, silence, deterrence, protected activity, and external outcomes in later validation.
